notes: Source pages (PDF page = printed page + 2): INDIVIDUAL RECORDS PDF pp. 295-299 (printed 293-297) with 'Most, Career / Most, Season / Most, Game' top-3 lines per category; CAREER TOP 10 PDF pp. 305-306 (printed 303-304); SINGLE-SEASON TOP 10 PDF pp. 307-308 (printed 305-306). Career and season lists come from the two Top 10 tables (printed ranks, 10 rows); game lists come from the 'Most, Game' lines of the Individual Records (the guide prints no game Top 10).

Cross-check inside the guide: for every career and season category the top 3 lines of the Individual Records agree with the Top 10 table, EXCEPT sacks: the Individual Records season list includes pre-1982 seasons (Gary Johnson 17.5 in 1980, Steve DeLong 17.0 in 1969, Fred Dean 15.5 in 1978) while the Single-Season Top 10 is headed 'QUARTERBACK SACKS (since 1982)'. Season sacks therefore has TWO lists (the Individual Records one first, then the 'since 1982' Top 10 one). The game sacks line is headed 'Most, Game (since 1982)'.

Career sacks (Top 10, no 'since 1982' marker) includes pre-1982 totals: Gary Johnson 1975-84, Fred Dean 1975-81, Leroy Jones 1976-83. Leslie O'Neal's years print '1986, 1988-95' in the Top 10 and '1986-95' in the Individual Records.

through_season 2025: the guide is the 2026 media guide (IA date 2026-09-09) and its records include 2025 entries (Keenan Allen 2013-23, 25; Justin Herbert 2020-25; Tuli Tuipulotu 4.0 sacks Sept. 28, 2025; Cameron Dicker 2025).

Printed rank oddities kept as printed: season TD passes lacks the '3.' label for the two 33-TD rows (rank 3 inferred); season rush TDs labels the five 12-TD rows '8.' (competition ranking would give 9); career/season rows after a tie print no rank number.
Keenan Allen's years print '2013-23, 25' in the Top 10 (the Individual Records page prints '2013-23, '25').

Game lists: the guide prints top-3 value lines, ties named, and aggregated lines '5 (4x), Last: Drew Brees ...', '4 (32x), Last: J.Herbert ...', '3 (22x), Last: M.Gordon ...', '3 (14x) Last: D.Woodhead ...', '2 (87x) Last: Tarheeb Still ...'. Each is kept as ONE row dated with the last game (fields times, note, hidden_tie=true); the other games and players are not printed. Names in those lines (J.Herbert, M.Gordon, D.Woodhead) are initials as printed.

The season INT Top 10 list prints a twelve-way tie at 7 below rank 3 (Casey Hayward 2016, Eric Weddle 2011, Darren Carrington 1993, Gill Byrd 1990/1989/1988, Danny Walters 1983, Bryant Salter 1972, Jim Hill 1969, Leslie 'Speedy' Duncan 1966, Bud Whitehead 1965, Dick Harris 1961); not transcribed.
Single-Season Top 10 sacks row 7 reads 'Tuli Tuipulotu .... 13.0' with no season printed (all other rows have one); rows from rank 7 down were left out.
No tackles list anywhere in the guide, so career/season/game tackles are in missing.

Not used: passes/points/other categories, 'Most Games 100 Yards', consecutive-game and average lists, postseason pages (printed pp. 316-319), team records, the all-time 300-yard passing / 100-yard rushing and receiving game lists (printed pp. 307-314).
